blocks.title: SmithersGUI factory
blocks.text: Native SwiftUI client for Smithers workflows, agent sessions, terminals, and tickets on macOS 14+ and iOS 17+. The Zig core (libsmithers) exposes a C ABI to Swift; Ghostty renders terminals. smthrs ci runs the Zig build, tests, and format check, the workflow helper tests, and repository hygiene with a local-first cache synced through build.smithers.sh.
